summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 21 April 2026 reporting a transaction in own shares, purchasing 5,000,000 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 101.977 pence per share (approximately £5.1 million). Purchases were made through Goldman Sachs International under an existing buyback program announced 30 January 2026, with shares intended to be cancelled. No board recommendation or advisors are named. This open-market repurchase reduces share count and returns capital to shareholders, executed under normal issuer buyback mechanics. Watch for further buyback updates and cancellation effect on EPS.
